programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Go-To Joints. Guy Fieri checks out beloved local places. In California a Puerto Rican restaurant serves an adobo steak sandwich and a kind of lasagne made with plantains. S6, Ep7

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Homestyle. Guy Fieri stops in at eateries serving home cooking. In Arizona, a musician prepares the recipes he learned living in Italy. In New Mexico a diner serves corned beef hash. S6, Ep8

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Return To Route 66. Guy takes an eastward tour of Route 66. In Albuquerque, NM, an old gas station-turned-diner makes classics like chicken-fried ahi tuna. S5, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: BBQ And More. Guy travels the US for top barbeque dishes. His finds include a former railroad car BBQ shack in Northern California making Philly cheese steaks with their brisket. S5, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: All Kinds Of Classics. Guy Fieri checks out classics across the US, beginning in Fort Worth and ending in Miami. And, actor Martin Sheen samples steak at a spicy roadside joint! S6, Ep9

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: All Over The Map. Guy Fieri heads to Phoenix, Seattle and San Francisco for a world of flavour. He visits a family-owned joint serving authentic Mexican tacos, and a Greek eatery. S6, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Old Time Favorites. Guy Fieri visits places keeping the past alive, with a local landmark, old-time lunch counters and a joint serving seafood like their grandparents did in Cuba. S6, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Comfort Cookin'. Guy Fieri catches some comfort food in Arizona, California and Wisconsin. Dishes include chilli cheddar cornbread and pumpkin oatmeal pancake. S6, Ep12

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Oklahoma City. Adam Richman is in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, for a presidential T-bone steak, the Sooner State original fried onion burger and a Fried Catfish Challenge. S2, Ep29

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Kansas City. Adam Richman is in Kansas City for some world-class barbecue, some of the best pan-fried chicken in the USA and the six-pound Ultimate Destroyer sandwich! S2, Ep30

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Indianapolis. Foodie Adam Richman is in Indianapolis, Indiana, for the Indy staple pork tenderloin sandwich, some Hoosier home cooking and the enormous Big Ugly Burger Challenge. S2, Ep31

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Jersey Shore. Adam is at the Jersey Shore checking out a Trenton-style tomato pie and mighty octopus-shaped ice cream sundae. Then, he tries an insanely spicy wing-eating challenge. S2, Ep32

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Syracuse. Adam Richman is in Syracuse, NY, checking out some serious grub. He tries the pork-sket sandwich at a biker BBQ joint. Then he takes on a monumental frittata challenge. S2, Ep33

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Portland, ME. Adam Richman visits the land of lighthouses and lobsters: Portland, Maine. He samples lobster right out of the pot and some of the best coastal views imaginable. S2, Ep34

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Niagara Falls. Adam gets romantic at Niagara Falls. Adam has a date with a steak that barely fits on a plate. Then he crosses the border for the Italian Challenge. S2, Ep35

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Butte. Adam tries a local staple in Butte, Montana: the pasty, a delicious meat-and-vegetable-filled pastry whose culinary tradition is as old as the mines. S2, Ep36

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Sacramento. In Sacramento, Adam visits the California State Fair for fried food on a stick. Later, he tucks into five pounds of chili-smothered hot dogs in the Knucklehead Challenge! S2, Ep37

programme.title: Man V. Food
programme.desc: Des Moines. Adam Richman is in Des Moines, Iowa, for some Midwestern comfort food, unique sandwich-inspired pizza and the five-pound Adam Emmenecker sandwich challenge. S2, Ep38

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James heads to the riverside town of Isle Sur La Sorge, where his food hero, Keith Floyd, once owned a restaurant. He cooks peaches pain perdu in the sunshine. S1, Ep15

programme.title: James Martin's French Adventure
programme.desc: James travels to Normandy, home to his all-time favourite ingredient, butter! He cooks up artichokes with hollandaise whilst visiting a Calvados orchard. S1, Ep16

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Paul and Prue set three tough challenges for the remaining 10 bakers in bread week. They include their own versions of teacakes and an ambitious sculpture showstopper. S8, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: For the very first time, it's caramel week! The remaining bakers face three sticky challenges, including a super sweet signature and a double-Dutch technical. S8, Ep4

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: It's pudding week and Paul and Prue expect perfection. They set a monumental technical challenge and a multi-layered trifle of a showstopper. S8, Ep5

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining bakers face a triple challenge in pastry week. They make a savoury signature, a multi-layered technical, and an ambitious traditional pie that really tests them. S8, Ep6

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: For Italian week, the bakers create a Sicilian signature and a deceptively tricky technical. The heat is on with a showstopper in the hottest temperatures recorded in the tent. S8, Ep7

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: The remaining five bakers go back in time with unfamiliar recipes for forgotten bakes week. There's a sweet and savoury signature challenge and Prue sets a boozy technical. S8, Ep8

programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman
programme.desc: Wok It Out. Adam Richman visits Hong Kong to find off-menu eats. Dishes include a giant tomahawk steak, and a hidden tea room's signature soup and wings. S2, Ep5

programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman
programme.desc: Undercover 'Que. Adam sleuths out London's tastiest eats, like a speakeasy disguised as a detective agency, a sundae that requires customers to dance and a barbecue sandwich. S2, Ep6

programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman
programme.desc: Raising The Steaks. Adam heads to Argentina in search of secret eats. He samples French toast from a steampunk speakeasy and an off-menu Mendozan stew served in a pumpkin. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Secret Eats With Adam Richman
programme.desc: Top Secret Tacos. Adam is on the hunt for secret eats in Mexico City. He finds an off-the-menu barbecue brisket sandwich and tacos in a secret speakeasy. S2, Ep8

programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes
programme.desc: San Francisco. Paul is in San Francisco, home to one of America's most iconic breads - sourdough. Plus, Paul visits a focaccia bakery and makes a savoury bread and butter pudding. S2, Ep7

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Tommy Banks. Prue welcomes award winning chef, Tommy Banks to her kitchen. She makes two-tone soup and husband John joins her for a goat's curd and tomato galette. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: BBQ And More. Guy travels the US for top barbeque dishes. His finds include a former railroad car BBQ shack in Northern California making Philly cheese steaks with their brisket. S5, Ep10

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Regional Classics. Guy Fieri checks out what the locals love. In Pittsburgh, a mall joint makes Polish haluski and Italian polenta and in Albuquerque tasty burritos are on the menu. S5, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Family Favorites. Guy Fieri takes a seat at the family table. In Arizona, a German eatery makes sauerbraten from scratch and in Northern California an old saloon serves lamb shanks. S5, Ep12

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: All Kinds Of Fast Food. Guy Fieri looks at fast food done right in New Mexico, Nebraska and Connecticut. He checks out green chilli cheeseburgers and deep-fried tacos. S5, Ep13

programme.title: Rick Stein's Fruits Of The Sea
programme.desc: Rick attempts to convert a fish phobic Henry, by catching a sea bass together and grilling it with a vanilla sauce. Plus, he shows a tasty way of cooking plaice. S1, Ep4

programme.title: Rick Stein's Seafood Odyssey
programme.desc: Rick Stein returns to Goa where he cooks a shark vindaloo and dhal with lentils. Plus, he travels to America and cooks Hangtown fry. S1, Ep4

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers Go North
programme.desc: West Yorkshire. The Bikers continue their tour in West Yorkshire. They cook a full English shakshuka with some blueberry muffins, as well as curried crab cakes. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Date Night. Molly Yeh makes a romantic meal for a date night with her husband. She serves up a menu including cheesy garlic muffins and a Valentine's Day box filled with nougats. S5, Ep7

programme.title: Jamie: Fast And Simple

programme.desc: Easy As Pie. Baking and blooms are on the menu as Ina shares the secrets of pie making with her florist friend Michael in exchange for some table centrepiece pointers. S11, Ep2

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: 12 of the UK's best amateur bakers compete to be crowned the Great British Bake Off champion. The technical challenge sees them all making a coffee and walnut Battenberg cake. S2, Ep1

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
